answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Business Question ID: 40112 Country: India Title: I have problem in business. First I start sale and service of computer in that I loss lots of cash, now I started stock market Question: I have problem in business. First I start sale and service of computer in that I loss lots of cash, now I started stock market. Can I get some dua to stop loss? Answer ID: 40112 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1103/684/L=1433) First you should ask any Mufti by writing the complete detail of your business whether this business is lawful or not. If they tell you that this business is lawful then go ahead with this business otherwise leave it. In order to save you from the loss in the business recite Ya Mughni (يا مغني) 11-11 times after Isha salah with durood 11-11 times before and after. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
